_comment: Card CB-Q leg C — RATE PROBE at 305 sta / 2 signals.  1 h of data; the ONE knob
vs its twin is network.epoch_decimation_n.  Purpose: find out whether the
measured 300 s DECISIVE NO-GO (project_dev300s_tier: over 300 s the DD carry
prediction is invalid — 0.9 cyc predicted vs 15 cyc actual — refloats 33 %/ep,
arc life ~15 min, and at deg-15 the SH field ran away to 2620 TECU over hr
4.1-4.7) still binds on THIS much smaller state vector, where the multi-channel
code-bias columns are gone by construction.  It was measured on the full
multi-signal posture; it is inheritance, not measurement, until re-run here.
READ (in order): D5 refloat rate per epoch and its σ̂₀ (carry prediction VALID
iff σ̂₀ ≈ 1 — 60 s measured 184/ep at σ̂₀ = 1.00, 300 s measured 2161/ep); the
a₀₀ physical-band WARN (the field-divergence probe, [2, 150] TECU); solved-epoch
count; s/epoch.  A tier that trips either of the first two is emission/datum
mechanics ONLY and cannot grade the code-bias channel, which sits downstream of
both the iono constraint and the carry.
GAP-GUARD LANDMINES CHECKED: phase_leveling_max_gap_s (900) and
clock_model_max_gap_s are INERT on this chain (phase_leveling and clock_model
are both off).  emit_pb_filter_gate k = 4 is the value measured to transfer
300 s <-> 30 s, and it is already inherited.  Per-second q's self-scale.
⚠ Epoch-denominated windows (carry_invariant_innov_calibrate_window 15,
emit_pb_filter_window_epochs 15, iono_constraint_deweight_window_epochs 15) are
left ALONE deliberately: the rate-transferable-windows card is unbuilt, and
hand-rescaling them here would make the probe more than one knob different.
300 s tier — the one the speed argument wants and the one on record as NO-GO.
